programme.title: Infinite Euphoria!

programme.title: Dance Anthems: 2000 - 2009

programme.title: Dance Anthems: 2000 - 2009

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.title: Below Deck Mediterranean
programme.desc: Captain Sandy has quite the dilemma on her hands with two hapless deckhands. And a demanding guest wants to go for a risky late-night swim.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: 24 Minutes: In a parody of the action series 24, Bart and Lisa must stop bullies releasing a stink bomb at school.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: You Kent Always Say What You Want: After spilling coffee on his lap, Kent Brockman swears on live TV and gets fired. So Kent and Lisa team up to broadcast inconvenient truths.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: A Tale of Two Bandits: Jeffords thinks the Pontiac Bandit's up to his old tricks again. The team battle some firefighters to keep Shaw's bar a police hangout.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: The Crime Scene: Peralta and Diaz doggedly work and rework a crime scene in an effort to solve a difficult murder case that's clouded by confusing evidence.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Larry's Wife: Phil seems to have found his niche in real estate - selling to recently divorced women. Luke invites his buddies over for a high-stakes poker game in the basement.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Farm Strong: Cam's sister Pam visits, and he desperately tries to hide the engagement until he can delicately break the news to her - but it turns out she has news of her own.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Late Show: Jay pulls strings to get a reservation at a hot new restaurant. Unfortunately, everyone is running late.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Help: Jay and Manny aren't happy when Gloria hires a too-good-to-be-true male nanny. Frank's in town and feeling lonely, so Phil and Jay take him out to get his groove back.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: Deux Hommes dans la Ville
programme.desc: Two Men in the City. 1973. Drama. Director: Jose Giovanni. Stars Jean Gabin & Alain Delon. Gino tries to rebuild his life after a ten year prison sentence while Inspector Goitreau harasses him.

programme.title: Fritz the Cat
programme.desc: Director: Ralph Bakshi. Stars Skip Hinnant, Rosetta LeNoire & John McCurry. A pretentious, womanizing young cat drops out of college and finds himself caught in all kinds of illegal business.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: Waiting for a Knighthood. 1972. Stars Simon Oates, John Barron, Frederick Jaeger. The team investigate a case of extreme lead poisoning. Soon after, the son of an oil company magnate is kidnapped.

programme.title: Flannelfoot
programme.desc: 1953. Crime drama directed by Maclean Rodgers and starring Ronald Howard and Mary Germaine. Crime news hack Mitchell is out to discover the identity of the notorious jewel thief 'Flannelfoot'.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: 1964. Who Killed Don Pablo? Directed by Richard Kinon. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. A waxwork in a museum turns out not to be a waxwork at all...

programme.title: It Happened In Soho
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Director: Frank Chisnell. Stars Richard Murdoch, Patricia Raine & Henry Oscar. Murder drama set in Soho involving a police inspector, a newspaper reporter and a country girl.

programme.title: Johnny On The Spot
programme.desc: 1954. Crime directed by Maclean Rogers. Johnny (Hugh McDermott) returns from a prison sentence to get the man who framed him.

programme.title: Automatic Fare Collection and You in 1969
programme.desc: Directed by Bob Privett. A short instructional film showing the correct and incorrect ways of getting tickets and going through the automatic gates with and without luggage.

programme.title: Desert Mice
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Set in WW2, this is the story of an ENSA troupe of entertainers. Starring Sid James, Dora Bryan, Alfred Marks and Liz Fraser.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful World
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy directed by Val Guest and starring Terence Morgan, George Cole, Kathleen Harrison. Two struggling composers hit on a novel way of producing music backwards!

programme.title: The Lucy Show
programme.desc: Lucy and the Monkey. 1966. Stars Lucille Ball, Gale Gordon & Hal March. Lucy is putting in long hours at the office which is leading to some strange hallucinations.

programme.title: Laxdale Hall
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Car owners of a remote Scottish village refuse to pay road funds until a proper road has been built. Starring Ronald Squire, Fulton Mackay & Prunella Scales.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Five To One. 1963. Directed by Gordon Flemyng. Stars Lee Montague, Ingrid Hafner & John Thaw. Alan Roper is a smart young man on the fringes of big time crime.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Vandals. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Rufus Cruickshank. Robin is blamed for a series of attacks and the Sheriff tries to capture him but where is the evidence?

programme.title: Maybe I'll Come Home in the Spring
programme.desc: 1971. Director: Joseph Sargent. Stars Sally Field, Eleanor Parker & Lane Bradbury. Dennie learns that the hippie lifestyle isn't as glamorous as it seems and comes home to judgement.

programme.title: Song Festival: The Andrews Sisters
programme.desc: Enjoy a short compilation of beautiful songs sung by The Andrews Sisters including, ''I'll Pray for You'', ''Il Bacio'' featuring Gloria Jean and ''Amen'' featuring Woody Herman.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: The Safe Way. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Kenneth Edwards & Robert Cawdron. Hunter investigates a claim when the fifth in a series of robberies occurs - all from new safes owned by the same family.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1970. The End of the Beginning. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Changes to the family become apparent over Christmas as an old will is discovered.

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: The Bells of Shoreditch. 1989. Stars: Robert Powell, Paul Rogers & Karen Archer. When his goddaughter is jilted on her wedding day, Hannay finds himself searching for a missing bridegroom.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: A Straight Deal. 1964. Stars Kate Allit, Alison Bayley & Larry Burns. £3000 is stolen in a house burglary, dynamite is found hidden in a shed and money is traded for freedom.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1971. Detective & Mystery Drama. John VII Verse 24. Stars Alfred Burke, Ray Smith & George A. Cooper. Marker is faced with a head-on collision with DI Firbank.

programme.title: Eyewitness (1971)
programme.desc: 1970. Drama. Directed by John Hough. Stars Mark Lester, Susan George & Lionel Jeffries. A boy is a witness to a killing. He goes on the run with his older sister, helped by their grandfather.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is back this week to introduce the next episode of Supernatural, in which Lady Sybil is seeing ghosts!

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.desc: Lady Sybil. 1977. Stars Cathleen Nesbitt, Denholm Elliott & John Osborne. Lady Sybil is frightened of a Phantom, she wonders if the ghost of her dead husband haunts the grounds.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Prepare for a night of mad scientists, monsters and murder because next up, Caroline Munro introduces a 1959 horror film: The Manster.

programme.title: The Manster
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Director: George P. Breakston. Stars Peter Dyneley, Jane Hylton & Tetsu Nakamura. A journalist is given a mysterious injection that turns him into a murderous monster.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: As the end of the night approaches, Caroline Munro is here to give you an insight into what is to come next week at the Cellar Club.

programme.title: Children Shouldn't Play With Dead Things
programme.desc: 1972. Directed by Benjamin Clark. Stars Alan Ormsby, Valerie Mamches and Jeffrey Gillen. Six weird friends go to the graveyard to raise the dead with terrifying results.

programme.title: The Monkey's Paw
programme.desc: 1948. Horror. A curio dealer sells a monkey's paw that can grant the possessor three wishes but warns that disaster will follow. Starring Michael Martin-Harvey, Sydney Tafler & Alfie Bass.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Yellow Robe. 1954. Stars Ron Randell, Nicholas Hill & Tony Penderell. A monk telephones to tell Frank that his brother is alive and well in a monastery. This call leads to the monk's death.

programme.title: Mistaken Identity
programme.desc: 1942. Comedy. Director: Walter Tennyson. Stars Richard Goolden, Gilliam Maude & Julian Vedey. Comedy of a booking clerk who is dismissed after a mistake and confused with a millionaire in London.

programme.title: The Christmas Tree
programme.desc: 1966. Family. Starring Brian Blessed, William Burleigh, Anthony Honour & Kate Nicholls. Gary determines to get a tree for children who will be in hospital for Christmas. Directed by Jim Clark.

programme.title: It's A Square Ring
programme.desc: 1953. See our very own Harry Secombe as an Army champion opposing the Navy champion. To make quite sure you really split your sides, Michael Bentine is the referee.

programme.title: Runaround
programme.desc: 1980. Presented by Mike Reid. Prizes include a train set, a cassette video game and more Guests include Band The Photos, exotic insects, radio-controlled model motorcycles, and more.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Dean and Thabo are reunited and, with Nina's help, devise a plan to rescue Kama.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Prisoner. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard, Jennifer Jayne & Michael Caine. On his way to deliver a message to William Tell, a resistance man is captured and taken to a fortress.

programme.title: Electric Refrigeration Get Up To Date
programme.desc: Take a nostalgic glimpse into 1958 with this short film about getting ''up to date'' by using electric refrigeration.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Penguin's Clean Sweep. 1968. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Yvonne Craig. The Penguin contaminates all the printed money with Lygerian Sleeping Sickness in order to claim them himself.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Powder Keg. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Bill Walker. Fur trader McKenzie initiates a war between the Hurons and the nearby settlement.

programme.title: Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons
programme.desc: Place of Angels. 1968. Stars Sylvia Anderson, Martin King & Donald Gray. Mysteron agent Judith Chapman steals a phial of a deadly virus which is capable of killing ten million people...

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Talisman of Sargon. 1961. Stars David Graham, Graydon Gould & George Murcell. The Supercar team are given the task of stopping Masterspy from getting control of the Talisman of Sargon.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Mistress Higgins' Treasure. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Adrienne Corri & Edwin Richfield. Whilst smuggling tools to desperate farmers, Dan meets a mysterious woman at sea who has a tale to tell.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Dream. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Bernadette O¿Farrell & Alan Wheatley. Maid Marian has a premonition that Robin is in grave danger, and he dismisses the warning. But is her intuition right?

programme.title: Killers From Space
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-fi Mystery. Directed by W. Lee Wilder. Stars Peter Graves, James Seay & Steve Pendleton. An atomic scientist injured in a plane crash makes a claim that he was abducted by aliens.

programme.title: The Green Man
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy. Stars Alastair Sim, Raymond Huntley, George Cole & Terry-Thomas. A watchmaker turns out to be an assassin whose target is a leading politician but his plans are stalled.

programme.title: Does It Worry You 1938
programme.desc: 1938. A short film about the annoying habits people have when going to the cinema, and how it disturbs everyone¿s viewing pleasure.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Dark Run's the Sea. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert & Reg Lye. A local magistrate cancels Cobb's shipping franchise after his niece is apparently kidnapped while riding on the stage.

programme.title: Reach For The Sky
programme.desc: 1956. War drama. Directed by Lewis Gilbert and stars Kenneth More, Muriel Pavlow and Lyndon Brook. This is the true story of Douglas Bader, who loses his legs but returns to flight during WW2.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Whipping Boy. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Christopher Benjamin & David Daker. The rivalry between the Captain & the Colonel rears up again, leaving Spiker demoted and Moat imposing terror.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Liberty Bar. 1960. Stars Rupert Davies, Renee Houston & Paul Eddington. No one knows what William Brown does when he visits Cannes every month, but one day he returns with a knife in his back.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: The Passing Show. 1977. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & T.P. McKenna. Louisa urges Charlie to get on with his life and a smooth and very suave actor beds Violet, who gets the sack.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Last Vampyre
programme.desc: 1993. Drama. Director: Tim Sullivan. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke & Roy Marsden. Sherlock Holmes investigates strange and tragic happenings in a village where an unusual man resides.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1996. Tonight, Lolo Ferrari introduces videos including Costas Tournes, Locomia and her own latest offering. Enjoy a live performance from the Russian boy band Na Na!

programme.title: Fortean TV
programme.desc: 1997. Hosted by Reverend Lionel Fanthorpe. Tonight, explore a lake in search for a monster, discover the secrets of immortality and go shopping for, what some believe, is a message from above.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Burning Girl. 1959. Stars Olive Deering, Luana Anders & Edward Platt. A shy teenage girl who is trying to fit into a new community, has to coexist with her abusive aunt and insensitive father.

programme.title: Adam Had Four Sons
programme.desc: 1941. Drama. Directed by Gregory Ratoff. Stars Ingrid Bergman, Susan Hayward & Warner Baxter. A French governess becomes the centre of a wealthy family after the death of her employer's wife.

programme.title: The Perfect Woman (1981)
programme.desc: 1978. Two dumb aliens are sent to earth to find an earthwoman suitable to be the wife of their leader. Stars Cameron Mitchell.

programme.title: Profile
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director Francis Searle and starring John Bentley, Kathleen Byron and Thea Gregory. The editor of a magazine is keen on the boss's daughter but her mother is keen on him.

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Come To Me, My Litigation Baby! Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and stars Anne Francis. Honey investigates a man who claims he was paralysed by falling down the stairs.

programme.title: Unknown World
